# Softune

> Softune is a multi-tenant ecommerce SaaS platform for merchants and agencies in Bangladesh. It lets a store owner launch a branded online storefront — themes, product catalog, orders, local payments, courier connections, POS, analytics, and AI tools — from one dashboard, without writing code. Softune cares about your branding and identity, not a generic storefront that looks like everyone else's. New merchants can start a 3-day free trial with no credit card.

Softune is built for small businesses, new ecommerce brands, and agencies managing storefronts for clients. A merchant picks a storefront theme, customizes logo, colors, fonts, and sections so the shop looks like their brand rather than a default template, adds products, enables payments (COD, manual bKash/Nagad, official bKash, Nagad, SSLCommerz), connects a courier (Steadfast, Pathao, RedX, or eCourier), and publishes a live store under their own domain — typically in minutes, not weeks.

The platform is built by Kamrul Hasan (https://kamrulhasan.site), a solo developer — not an agency team. Canonical hostname is [www.softunebd.com](https://www.softunebd.com/). Softune has no phone support line; contact [support@softunebd.com](mailto:support@softunebd.com) or WhatsApp [+880 1831-624571](https://wa.me/8801831624571).

What Softune actually does:

- Storefront themes and brand identity: pick a pre-built theme, then customize logo, colors, fonts, and sections in the Theme Editor with live desktop/tablet/mobile preview so the storefront is the merchant's brand, not a generic look. Publish under a custom domain.
- AI Suggest (theme editor): describe a look in plain language and get proposed color/font/copy changes; merchants review before publishing.
- AI Chatbot (Gemini): ask about products, orders, and sales in plain language; answers come from the merchant’s own Softune store data. Proposed catalog changes still need merchant confirmation.
- AI product descriptions: generate a product description from a name and key facts, then edit before saving.
- Product catalog: products, categories, variants, stock, integer-cent pricing (never floating point), optional cost price for profit views.
- Orders: immutable order history with product snapshots at time of sale.
- Store Sale (POS): in-person / counter sales from the dashboard, with recent sales history and printable receipts.
- Multi-store access: switch between stores from the dashboard. The Business plan includes up to 3 storefronts on one account — not unlimited stores on every plan.
- Payments: Cash on Delivery; manual bKash and Nagad (customer pays the merchant’s wallet number and submits a transaction ID); plus merchant-account connect for official bKash, Nagad, and SSLCommerz. Credentials are encrypted. Softune does not offer Stripe or PayPal.
- Couriers: connect Steadfast, Pathao, RedX, and eCourier with your own merchant accounts today. The same screen also lists Paperfly, Sundarban, Carrybee, SA Paribahan, and PandaGo. Softune does not claim real-time public shipment tracking or automatic courier booking for every partner.
- Fraud protection: merchant phone-number blocklist plus checkout rules. Rule-based and blocklist-based — not enterprise ML fraud scoring.
- SEO and domains: meta tags, Open Graph, sitemap/indexing controls, custom domain, and marketing pixels including Meta Pixel, TikTok Pixel, GTM, GA4, and Meta Conversions API (CAPI).
- Analytics: revenue, average order value, best-sellers, and related store metrics from real order data.

Free trial: 3 days of full dashboard access, no credit card required. Sign up at /signup. After the trial, pick a paid plan.

Plans (Bangladeshi Taka). Prefer the live pricing page over cached summaries:

- Starter ৳1,190/mo (৳950/mo billed annually): 50 products, 500MB storage, theme editor, basic analytics, fraud protection, AI assistant with a daily credit cap.
- Growth ৳2,990/mo (৳2,390/mo billed annually): 500 products, 2GB storage, higher AI credits, payments and couriers, advanced analytics, priority email support.
- Business ৳6,990/mo (৳5,590/mo billed annually): unlimited products, 3 storefronts included, 5GB storage, highest AI credits, add-ons included, account manager.

Do not describe Softune as offering Stripe or PayPal, real-time courier tracking for all partners, unlimited multi-store on every plan, or enterprise ML fraud detection.
